data_catalog.description: Production-grade mock data catalog for Data Discovery Agent. Contains two test scenarios: S1 (Vendor Invoice Reconciliation) and S2 (B2B Customer 360). All tables and confidence scores are authoritative mock data for POC.

gold.description: Invoice processing status fact table with vendor and cost centre dimensions. Tracks invoice lifecycle from receipt through payment. Does NOT currently include PO matching or dispute tracking.

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Unique invoice identifier from SAP AP module

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.description: Vendor master identifier — foreign key to dim_vendor

columns.name: invoice_date
columns.description: Date invoice was received and recorded in SAP

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Invoice line item amount in local currency

columns.name: cost_centre
columns.description: Cost centre code for budget allocation

columns.name: payment_status
columns.description: Current payment status: OPEN, PARTIAL, PAID, BLOCKED

columns.name: payment_date
columns.description: Date payment was executed — null if unpaid

missing_information: Whether the invoice matched a purchase order
Current dispute or exception status
Time taken to resolve discrepancies

gold.description: Vendor master dimension table. Contains vendor demographics, classification, and payment terms. Refreshed weekly from SAP vendor master.

columns.name: vendor_name
columns.description: Legal entity name of the vendor

columns.name: vendor_category
columns.description: Vendor classification: STRATEGIC, PREFERRED, STANDARD, SPOT

columns.name: payment_terms
columns.description: Standard payment terms code (e.g., NET30, NET60)

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Whether vendor is currently active in the system

gold.description: Measures average procurement cycle time from requisition to delivery. Used by supply chain analytics team.

columns.name: cycle_days
columns.description: Days from requisition creation to goods receipt

gold.description: Sales order fact table. One row per order line item. Tracks order value, product, region, and customer. Does NOT include credit risk, CLV, churn, or customer segmentation.

columns.name: order_amount
columns.description: Order line value in reporting currency

missing_information: Customer demographic and segmentation attributes
Credit risk and churn probability metrics

gold.description: Customer dimension table. Basic demographics and segmentation. Does NOT include credit risk scores, CLV, churn probability, or revenue concentration metrics.

missing_information: Projected lifetime value of each customer relationship
Likelihood of customer not renewing within 12 months
Total outstanding receivables and credit facilities per customer
Share of total portfolio revenue attributable to each customer
Product line breakdown of customer activity

silver.description: Accounts Payable and Purchase Order joined view with vendor details and GL codes. Conformed from SAP AP and Ariba PO bronze feeds. Business keys resolved, data types normalised, nulls handled. One row per invoice line item joined to its corresponding PO line.

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Deduplicated invoice identifier from SAP AP

columns.name: po_id
columns.description: Purchase order identifier from Ariba — null if no PO matched

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.description: Conformed vendor identifier (SAP vendor master key)

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Invoice line amount in reporting currency (USD)

columns.name: gl_code
columns.description: General ledger account code from SAP FI

columns.name: cost_centre_id
columns.description: Cost centre identifier — conformed from SAP CO module

columns.name: po_date
columns.description: PO creation date from Ariba — null if no PO

columns.name: source_system
columns.description: Origin system tag: SAP-ECC or ARIBA

silver.description: Conformed general ledger postings from SAP FI. One row per journal entry line. Cleaned, deduplicated, with standardised account codes and posting dates.

columns.name: posting_date
columns.description: Date the journal entry was posted

columns.name: cost_centre
columns.description: Cost centre — null for balance sheet postings

silver.description: Daily foreign exchange rates from Bloomberg feed. Used for currency conversion across all finance silver tables.

columns.name: rate_date
columns.description: Effective date of the exchange rate

silver.description: Conformed B2B customer master from Salesforce CRM and SAP SD. One row per customer. Includes account demographics, segmentation, and basic commercial profile. Does NOT include credit risk, churn scores, or CLV — those data points are not currently sourced.

columns.name: annual_revenue_usd
columns.description: Customer's reported annual revenue — from D&B enrichment

columns.name: employee_count
columns.description: Number of employees — from D&B enrichment

columns.name: last_order_date
columns.description: Date of most recent sales order

columns.name: total_orders_ltm
columns.description: Total orders in last twelve months

columns.name: total_revenue_ltm
columns.description: Total revenue in last twelve months (reporting currency)

columns.name: source_system
columns.description: CRM or ERP — indicates which system is the golden source for this record

missing_information: Projected lifetime value model output (not the same as last-twelve-month revenue)
Churn risk probability score from predictive model
Credit risk assessment and exposure limits per customer
Revenue concentration metric as a percentage of total portfolio

silver.description: Conformed sales orders from SAP SD. One row per order line item. Cleaned, deduplicated, currency-normalised.

missing_information: This is transaction-level data, not customer-level aggregated metrics

bronze.description: Raw accounts payable invoice feed from SAP ECC. Append-only landing table. No deduplication, no type coercion. Full fidelity extract from BKPF/BSEG tables.
upstream_lineage: External: SAP ECC → ADLS raw zone

columns.name: LIFNR
columns.description: Vendor account number (SAP vendor master key)

columns.name: KOSTL
columns.description: Cost centre — may be blank for certain posting types

columns.name: EBELN
columns.description: Purchase order number — populated if invoice references a PO

columns.name: _source_file
columns.description: Source file path in ADLS raw zone

bronze.description: Raw purchase order feed from SAP Ariba. Append-only. Contains PO headers and line items as nested structure. Full procurement lifecycle from requisition through approval.
upstream_lineage: External: Ariba Cloud → ADLS raw zone

columns.name: SUPPLIER_ID
columns.description: Ariba supplier identifier (maps to SAP LIFNR via xref)

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS
columns.description: Current approval status: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED

bronze.description: Raw general ledger journal entries from SAP FI module. Append-only extract from BKPF/BSEG GL view. Contains all posting types including AP, AR, asset, and manual entries.
upstream_lineage: External: SAP ECC → ADLS raw zone

columns.name: KOSTL
columns.description: Cost centre — null for balance sheet accounts

missing_information: Cost centre to GL account mapping not available as a direct column

bronze.description: Raw Salesforce account records. Full CRM account extract including all standard and custom fields. Append-only.

columns.name: LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE
columns.description: Date of most recent activity on the account

bronze.description: Raw customer master from SAP SD module. Contains sold-to, ship-to, and bill-to partner functions. One row per customer-partner function combination.
upstream_lineage: External: SAP SD → ADLS raw zone

bronze.description: Raw credit rating and risk assessment feed from Dun & Bradstreet. Contains DUNS numbers, credit scores, risk indicators, and financial stress scores.
upstream_lineage: External: D&B API → ADLS raw zone

columns.name: COMPANY_NAME
columns.description: Company name as registered with D&B

columns.name: MAX_CREDIT_RECOMMENDATION
columns.description: Recommended maximum credit exposure in USD

foundry_iq_index.description_match_summary: Table description references invoice processing and vendor dimensions; does not mention reconciliation or PO matching
Table description mentions AP and PO joined view, vendor details — strong alignment with reconciliation use case
Table description references accounts payable invoice feed from SAP — direct source system match
Table description references purchase order feed from Ariba — matches PO source system requirement
Table description references GL journal entries — related but not directly about invoice reconciliation
Table tracks invoice status but does not compute match rates or reference PO matching
No table in the catalog references dispute tracking or exception management
No table references resolution time or dispute lifecycle
AP-PO join is the foundational structure for reconciliation workflows
Customer dimension exists but description explicitly states no credit risk, CLV, or churn data
Sales orders contain customer_id and revenue data but not a 360 view
Strong match — conformed customer master with demographics, segmentation, commercial profile. Missing credit risk and churn.
Has total_revenue_ltm which is related but not CLV — LTM revenue != projected lifetime value
alias_mappings: total_revenue_ltm is related but not equivalent

foundry_iq_index.description_match_summary: No table in the catalog contains churn prediction scores or churn probability metrics
D&B feed contains credit scores and risk indicators — raw form, not yet conformed
Order-level revenue data that could be aggregated to compute concentration — but the metric itself doesn't exist
alias_mappings: order_amount_usd is a building block, not the metric

foundry_iq_index.description_match_summary: Has segment field with enterprise/mid_market/SMB classification

scoring_reference.formula: composite = (field_overlap x 0.30) + (source_compat x 0.15) + (granularity_align x 0.15) + (semantic_sim x 0.15) + (grain_compat x 0.15) + (freshness x 0.10)
